title: Keto Arabian Lentil Pilaf
description: A keto twist on the traditional Arabian lentil pilaf, made with warm spices and a variety of textures.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the warm spices and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the lentils and rice cauliflower to the skillet, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the Arabian spices and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the ghee and salt, and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the pilaf hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
Note: This dish is best served immediately, as the cauliflower will start to lose its texture after 30 minutes.
